strings.en: I have to hold that one off...!
This machine isn't mine alone.../　So...!
I must take care of Ryu's machine...!
With the Boxer, I can use what Ryu taught me!
I'll draw Al-Van's attention, even a little...!
I won't be cowed by that bloodlust...!
The Emperor Unit... Is that the source/　of Gu-Landon's confidence?
As long as Gu-Landon is around,/　Earth and the Fury have no future...!
Reggiane, I won't let you get in our way...!
Using the Cross Gate like that...!
Laughing like that gives away your position.
I won't let Debudedabide have its way...!
I have to avoid a direct hit...!
I sense the thoughts of something inhuman...!
Even if you control that unit...!
If I aim for those wings...!
That one's a Dark Brain remnant too...!
I won't accept your so-called mission...!
I'll shoot down the Zovorg unit...!
I won't let Golaikunru have its way...!
I need to watch out for that unit...!
I have to draw the enemy's attention to me...!
I have to stop the Org-Valu...!
If I can get through the barrage...!
Challenging the Baran-Schneil head-on/　is dangerous, but...!
I'll do it, even against the Fury...!
I can't let my guard down against that new model...!
Thorn, huh. I'd better be careful...!
For now, I'll open an escape route...!
I have to keep the damage down...!
I have to erase them one by one...!
I won't be dragged in/　by that negative will...!
At that size, I can still handle it...!
I can't flinch at a Kaana type...!
The Ares Geist has come back...!
I won't let Skull Knight have its way...!
I won't back down like this...!
I won't let you get out of range!
Ugh!/　I-I can't lose this machine...!
I can't leave that Lamaris Kaana alone!
If the Ida type does any more damage...!
I should... still be all right!
Something like that won't/　throw my focus off...!
I have to do this right.../　or Ryu and the others will worry...!
I must feel their movements more...!
My p-power is flowing back into me...!?
The AM Parts are still intact!
If I waste time on Reggiane...!
If things keep going/　Herluga's way like this...!
Ugh, Debudedabide pushed me this far...!
I can't lose to the Crystal Dragoon...!
I have to keep up with Skull Knight's movements...!
Being destroyed like this.../　I'll never let that happen...!
I won't be beaten by some monster!
If I don't stop the unknowns,/　the people in the city...!
I have to beat that Lamaris fast...!
What's with the way it moves!
Ngh... The malice is clinging to me...!
I have to keep up/　with the Ares Geist's speed...!
I can't keep up with the Yokijin...!
I'm fine... This much is nothing.
No problems with the T-Link System...
I reacted too late to Al-Van...!
I have to pull Herluga/　away from the Cross Gate...!
I couldn't shake off the Crystal Dragoon...!
I couldn't read Skull Knight's movements...!
I can't waste time on the Lamaris...!
A Kaana type moving like that...!
I won't stay in one place forever!
I have more than one evasion pattern...!
As long as I don't stop moving...!
I'll handle even the Emperor Unit...!
I have to break through that Gyanonia fast...!
I won't be beaten by Herluga!
I can't let it possess me...!
You won't hit me, Crystal Dragoon.
Targeting me is useless, Skull Knight.
I'm used to fighting that machine!
I can't let it absorb me...!
I can't be beaten by the Lamaris...!
It got bigger, so it's slower...!
As if I'd let a Yokijin catch me!
Lucky it attacked by the book...!
Something like that was in/　an anime Ryu showed me...
Got the field up in time...!
I lost sight of the enemy...!
I won't let that opening slip by!
Ryu, leave the rest to me!
Ryu made an opening for me...!
Captain Viletta, I'll take it from here...!
Latune, leave the rest to me.
Princess Shine, I'll take it from here...!
For Masaki, Shiro, and Kuro too...!
Akimi, leave the rest to me.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I won't let you do as you please!
I can at least do this much!
I won't let them get Aya!
I won't let them get Soul Saber!
I won't let this chance slip!
System connect...! Mai, here we go!
Got it, Aya...!/　T-Link Twin Contact!
I'll try it like Ryu does...!
Continuous Attack... can you dodge it?!
A combo I learned from Ryu!
Mai, let's go with the/　T-Link Continuous Attack Fist!
Take this, take this, take thiiiis!!
All right! Let's keep it going!!
I can see you... You won't escape!
Not a single one gets away!
Heaven and Earth!/　Telekinetic Shattering Sword!!
Show me what you've got, white kitty girl.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
You mean my Final Hell thingy?
Doing DTD in the flesh? Pretty reckless~?
Don't think you can stop me!
There's no escape from the Varga!
I'll push through with the Varga's firepower!
